# **REALM GRINDER A2** **Builds Master Reference Document**

---

# **Introduction**

## **Organization:**

This document will be broken down into 3 sections \- one for each stage of the ascension. Each section will have builds for the following:

* **Production Builds** are designed to maximize gems gained per Era and push to the next reincarnation. Some of these builds \- especially in later Ascensions \- require some measure of buffing or prerequisites to be fully optimal.  
* **Buff Builds** are designed to maximize the production of a specific stat \- be it Clicks, Spells Cast, Mana Produced, Assistant counts, Elven Luck, you name it. These may also be called Buff Builds in later Ascensions because the stats in question are key to major buffs or upgrades in those Ascensions.  
* **Unlock Builds** are designed for a specific thing for the rest of the ascension. These are meant to be run at most once to complete the specific unlock requirement.

## **Formatting:**

Each build will follow a specific format to keep everything streamlined, ensure maximum comprehension, and provide easy searching within this document. See below for an example with notes for explanation:

| UDFC | Title line, starting with Bloodline/Faction abbreviation and may have an extra note about the purpose of the build |
| :---- | :---- |
| RANGE: R112+, 0-e50 gems | This is the minimum reincarnation at which the build can run, plus the gem range at which the build works best. |
| FACTION: Faceless | The faction to be used for the run, and the second abbreviation of the build title |
| BLOODLINE: Undead | The bloodline to be used for the run, and the first abbreviation of the build title |
| SET: Dwarf | The artifact set to be used for the run. Unlock these by excavating for the new faction-specific artifacts. |
| STONEHEART: Angel | (R148+) The secondary set to be used for the run, gained via the MKC4 challenge reward of the same name. Balance Factions Only. |
| RESEARCHES: SX,SY,SZ,SA,SB,SC,CX,CY,CZ,CA,CB,CC,DX,DY,DZ,DA,DB,DC,EX,EY,EZ,EA,EB,EC,AX,AY,AZ,AA,AB,AC,WX,WY,WZ,WA,WB,WC | The list of applicable researches to be used for the build, listed in the order in which the researches need to be bought. It’s meant to be imported directly as a template. |
| Mobile:S200,S300,S1450,C281,C375,C1300,C1325,C1500,D250 | All researches in a single line for easier copying to mobile app |
| GAMEPLAY NOTES: | (optional) This section will include any specific elements of gameplay to be mindful of: such as specific spellcasting order, buff targeting, spell tier limits. If there are research or set alternatives to be mindful of, they are also posted here (Such as “If Spells Cast \>= 1eX, swap SX with SD” |
| NOTABLE BUFFS: | (optional) If the build gains power from having a specific stat buffed via a utility build, that stat will be listed here. |

GAMEPLAY NOTES:

* Lineage Order:  
  * R110-R112: Undead to L27  
  * R115: Undead & Fairy to L30  
  * R120-R122: All Lineages to L30, Fairy to L33-35, do Faceless and Dragon last  
* The build also works without Dwarf Set, in this case use Faceless Set and swap W200 \> W1375 (this should only be done for Undead L27).  
* If the build has higher mana regen than max mana, replace S3200 with S200.  
* If you have more than 4.5 hours of offline time this R, replace C1325 with C305.

* C340 \> C3100 at high gems.

### **ARDM**

RANGE: R139+, e95+ gems  
Prereqs: DJC2 unlocked  
FACTION: Demon  
BLOODLINE: Archon  
SET: Demon

RESEARCHES:  
S400,S525,S3200,  
C50,C305,C1325,  
D10,D250,D650,D3350,  
E150,E230,E450,E575,  
A25,A150,A400,A510,  
W1,W135,W175,W205,W501,W600,W700

Mobile:  
S400,S525,S3200,C50,C305,C1325,D10,D250,D650,D3350,E150,E230,E450,E575,A25,A150,A400,A510,W1,W135,W175,W205,W501,W600,W700

GAMEPLAY NOTES:

* Optimum Setup (See below for targeting):   
  * Drow Union on Pavilions/Evil Fortresses,  
  * Maelstrom targeting Pavilions/Evil Fortresses based on Trophies,  
  * Limited Wish targeting Trophies,  
  * Catalyst targeting Gem Grinder and GG/NT/GH/FC,  
  * DJC4 targeting assistants.  
* Targeting Priority:  
  * Usually Pavilions are best thanks to ARP1, but Evil Fortresses are close.   
    You can check which one is better by turning off Maelstrom and Drow Union.  
* After initial setup use buy all max to get all buildings to the same price, then buy single buildings to target Drow Union. After that only use buy all 1000 (or buy all 100\) to keep the Drow Union target.  
* The build grows significantly with LW casts and offline time this R. It might take a while to see gem growth.  
* Casting LW only to T2 is possible for more consistency, though T3 does give the most production.  
* For “active” play: you can Reverse Autocast Maelstroms to target necessary buildings with Trophies every 2 seconds, swapping S3200 \> S200 for a long Maelstrom is also possible, but reduces production somewhat.  
* (R153+) Once ARC5 & MKC5 are unlocked, switch C305 \> C3100 for short runs.

NOTABLE BUFFS:

* Offline Time (Set to DJUD before shutting off)  
* Spells Cast \+ Mana Produced (DJAN), 20-60m  
* Recommended minimal offline times:  
  R139: 40m  
  R140: 50m  
  R141: 1h  
  R142: 1h 15m  
  R143: 1h 30m  
  R144: 1h 50m  
  R145: 2h 10m  
  R146: 2h 40m  
  R147: 3h 10m  
  R148: 3h 20m  
  R149: 4h  
  R150: 4h 40m (18h after ARC4)  
  R151: 3h

  R154: 1h 15m  
  R155: 1h 30m

# **All Templates**

Format:  
Reincarnation Range  
Build Type (production, challenge/unlock, specific buff)  
Gem Range (sometimes not given if it’s not that relevant)  
Bloodline-Faction-Set
